model.name: H2AIR Integrated Model
model.description: Single-entry H2AIR model with separated user inputs, automatic lifting-surface sizing, measured linear-mass manufacturing model, polar-based airfoils, CAD export, discrete hardware selection and IE-SOAR cross-fuselage cooling integration.

propeller_clearance_checks.name: lift_propeller_to_pod
propeller_clearance_checks.message: Minimum top-view lift-disk to pod clearance: 20.0 mm. Screening only because the propeller diameter is not yet supplier/measured final hardware.

propeller_clearance_checks.name: pusher_disk_to_boom_lateral_clearance
propeller_clearance_checks.message: Minimum pusher disk-edge to boom-envelope lateral clearance: 134.3 mm. Screening only because the propeller diameter is not yet supplier/measured final hardware.

propeller_clearance_checks.name: pusher_plane_to_tail_le_axial_clearance
propeller_clearance_checks.message: Pusher disk-plane to horizontal-tail leading-edge axial separation: 79.6 mm. Screening only because the propeller diameter is not yet supplier/measured final hardware.

design_gates.name: hardware_mass_completeness

design_gates.name: reference_static_margin
design_gates.message: Cross-check only: uses the inherited neutral point from the current aero/stability model. At that fixed neutral point, reaching 5.0% MAC would require CG x <= 0.4782 m (about 0.0 mm forward from this ledger). Aero/propulsion/6 must recompute the neutral point after geometry/CG updates.

metadata.purpose: Structural load-case, strength, stiffness and mass-feedback screening for the H2AIR-4+1 UAV using Phase-3 geometry and Phase-6 control-allocation implications.
metadata.fidelity_boundary: Beam/tube calculations are screening fidelity. CFRP is treated as an equivalent isotropic tube material; laminate orientation, joints, inserts, adhesive bonds, printed anisotropy, local buckling, fatigue, impact, vibration and aeroelasticity require supplier data/FEA/test evidence before flight release.
metadata.critical_rule: Strength PASS is not sufficient. Stiffness/deflection is a separate hard design gate. Unknown local mount geometry remains NOT_EVALUATED rather than being assumed safe.

notes: AUTO selection is a database screening step. Final propulsion release requires measured thrust/power/thermal data at the selected voltage and propeller.
Battery current screen conservatively assumes simultaneous maximum lift + pusher database power.
Aircraft bus ceiling is 48.0 V (fuel-cell max); hardware bus_max is capped accordingly (not 12S×4.2=50.4 V).

main_wing.note: Screening polar approximating NACA 6415 at Re 2e5 (alpha0~-5, CLmax~1.55 in polar; CLmax_screen 1.37 for area sizing). Replace with measured/XFOIL at flight Reynolds before design freeze.

horizontal_tail.note: Uses the user-supplied XFOIL polar table directly. Values outside the table alpha range are clamped, not extrapolated.

vertical_tail.note: Uses the user-supplied XFOIL polar table directly. Values outside the table alpha range are clamped, not extrapolated.
